title: Sebrae e ApexBrasil anunciam startups selecionadas para o Web Summit Lisboa 2026 (Agência Sebrae)
what_it_says: Sebrae and ApexBrasil chose 100 Brazilian startups for the official delegation to Web Summit Lisboa 2026. The 40 best-ranked startups get financial support from Sebrae. Sebrae expects about 300 Brazilian startups in the delegation it leads in 2026.
